description: Publication-grade completion-or-attributable-failure and resource-boundary evidence on a rounded public synthetic grid with dynamic cases and an invariant-network control.

notes: Every shape belongs to a rounded author-defined public synthetic grid and is not projected from application data.
The workflow executes only the policy frozen by the same-budget efficiency phase.
Results are publication-grade completion-or-attributable-failure and measured resource-boundary evidence, not a biological-accuracy endpoint.
